meta.title: SEL-508: Implement code splitting and lazy loading
meta.body_summary: Implement code splitting and lazy loading for a React Native mobile app by configuring manual chunks in Vite, lazy-loading navigation screens, wrapping navigation in Suspense, dynamically importing heavy providers, and adding a crypto loader utility.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex PR for code splitting with lazy loading in React Native app; merged after iterative bot reviews and author fixes; no performance benchmarks but build/lint checks passed.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 1416 changed lines across 47 files, this is a medium-sized refactor by absolute volume. It fits a cross-cutting performance optimization (code splitting) that required changes to bundler config, navigation, and many component files, and successfully merged after iterative review.

review_details.concern_detail: coderabbitai flagged that SuspenseFallback used <div> instead of React Native View, which would cause runtime errors; also highlighted duplicate imports, deprecated Gradle options, and suggested proper type annotations for dynamic imports.
review_details.performance_claim: Improve app startup performance by implementing code splitting and lazy loading for screens and heavy dependencies (crypto, animations).

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Implementing code splitting in a React Native monorepo required understanding Metro/Vite bundler configs, React.lazy/Suspense constraints, and type-only imports. The initial implementation had React Native incompatibility (div vs View) and import resolution issues, requiring multiple fixes.

detection_detail.code_reading: coderabbitai performed static analysis and flagged React Native incompatibility, deprecated Gradle options, and suggested import improvements.
detection_detail.ci_auto: GitHub Actions ran lint, build, and type checks; build scripts were adjusted to pre-build dependencies.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No performance benchmarks; only build and lint checks verify correctness. The performance gain is assumed from standard code-splitting benefits.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: All issues raised in reviews were addressed by follow-up commits before merge.

core_change_summary.description: Introduced code splitting and lazy loading for navigation screens and heavy modules (crypto, animations) via React.lazy and dynamic imports; modified Vite manualChunks, Metro config, and import paths; wrapped app in Suspense with fallback; added loadCryptoUtils/loadProvingUtils for deferred crypto library loading.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Many files had import refactoring to use type-only imports and granular submodules, which supports tree shaking but is not direct performance evidence.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: implemented basic code splitting with React.lazy for screens and dynamic import for crypto modules.
CodeRabbit review flagged critical React Native incompatibility (HTML div in SuspenseFallback) and various code quality issues.

Subsequent commits: replaced div with native View, consolidated duplicate imports, added return types to cryptoLoader, adjusted Metro resolver, enabled Hermes engine, and fixed CI to build dependencies before linting.
After ~16 hours of iterative fixes and passing CI, PR merged with no further human objections.

review_signals.summary: SuspenseFallback uses HTML div instead of React Native View; will crash on mobile.
review_signals.action_taken: Fixed in commit 848071 by replacing div with View.

review_signals.summary: Duplicate imports from @selfxyz/common detected across multiple files; consolidate to a single import statement.
review_signals.action_taken: Fixed in commits 2270ada to d15a9b7 (imports consolidated).

review_signals.summary: cryptoLoader functions lack explicit return types; add proper TypeScript annotations.
review_signals.action_taken: Added return types in commit d55eec8.

review_signals.summary: dexOptions block is deprecated in AGP 7+; replace with modern build-type dexing configuration.
Explained that import path is correct and signing fallback is intentional for local runs.
CodeRabbit provided a detailed walkthrough and poem summarizing the PR changes.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened with initial code splitting implementation.
CodeRabbit bot immediately reviewed and flagged critical React Native incompatibility (div in SuspenseFallback) and numerous code quality issues.
Author committed fixes iteratively over the next ~16 hours, addressing most bot suggestions while also resolving Metro/import resolution, Android build config, and CI pipeline adjustments.
No human CHANGES_REQUESTED; merged after successful CI and all bot reviews returning COMMENTED.
